name: browser-use
headline: MCP Pointer - Guide AI with DOM elements
short_description: MCP Pointer lets you point at DOM elements in a browser to guide AI coding tools. Operations teams use it to streamline agentic coding workflows by allowing AI to see and interact with the same UI elements as humans. It connects to browser-based applications and integrates with agentic coding tools like Claude Code.
author: etsd-tech

sections.overview:
MCP Pointer is a local tool combining an MCP Server with a Chrome Extension that lets you visually select DOM elements in the browser and make that context available to agentic coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. By holding Option and clicking any element, you capture complete element data including text content, CSS classes, HTML attributes, positioning, styling, and React component information. The MCP server bridges the browser and AI tools via the Model Context Protocol, enabling AI assistants to see and analyze the same UI elements as humans. This eliminates the need to manually describe interface elements to your AI tool. Operations teams and developers use MCP Pointer to streamline agentic coding workflows by letting AI tools understand and interact with web applications through actual element context.
Quickly analyze the styling and attributes of a specific DOM element on a webpage.
Integrate AI tools to provide contextual insights about selected elements in real-time.
Facilitate debugging by extracting detailed information about React components directly from the browser.
Enhance web scraping tasks by obtaining structured data from targeted DOM elements effortlessly.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/etsd-tech/mcp-pointer`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
